proposition: After years alone on an island, everything he needs to get home to her fits in one 30L bag.

board.style_line: Cinematic castaway drama, 9:16 vertical, photoreal, sun-bleached tropical island, natural light only, anamorphic softness, muted teal-and-sand palette with a single saturated accent: the bright yellow lining of the Mokobara Transit Backpack.
board.negative_line: No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no captions, no named film or character likeness, no recognisable actor face, no extra straps, pockets or colours on the bag, no distorted hands.

identity_anchors.transit_backpack: Mokobara Transit Backpack: deep navy matte body, bright yellow lining, vertical front zip and front bucket pocket with two black zip pulls, black padded straps, small top grab handle
identity_anchors.castaway: a gaunt man in his forties, sun-darkened skin, long salt-matted dark beard and hair, wearing the shredded remains of a once-white shirt and rolled trousers, barefoot; an invented person, no likeness of anyone
identity_anchors.the_island: a small tropical island: white-grey sand beach, black volcanic rocks at the tide line, dense palms behind; the sea is always screen-left, the palms always screen-right
identity_anchors.wifes_photo: a palm-sized colour photograph with water-stained edges of a smiling dark-haired woman in a yellow kurta on a city balcony; an invented person, never held in sharp macro close-up

hero_frame.description: Low angle on gold-hour sand: the open navy backpack upright at frame centre, yellow interior blazing, ringed by a neatly laid-out survival haul (coconuts, leaf-wrapped dried fish, vine rope, flint, signal mirror), with a carved wooden paddle and a hand-made fishing spear lying across the foreground, both plainly longer than the bag, and the man's hands reaching in from frame right for the first coconut. The bag is small; the pile is not; the frame promises all of it is going in.

audio.music_bed: sparse low-strings drone under beats 1-3, a single warm piano motif introduced at the zip opening (beat 3) and resolved on the photo (beat 4), a soft percussive pulse under the packing (beat 5) with each zip click on the beat, opening out for the departure (beats 6-7), one held note on the brand close; no lyrics, no voice

beats.title: The handle in the surf
beats.feeling: A jolt of recognition before the viewer knows what they are looking at: something man-made and intact where nothing should be.
beats.framing: Extreme close-up, lens low to wet sand at the tide line. The small black top grab handle of the navy bag stands proud of a fan of white surf foam, frame centre; the two black zip pulls glint just below it. A wave drains back screen-left, pulling foam off the deep navy matte body. From frame right a sun-blackened, scarred hand with broken nails enters and closes around the handle.
beats.first_frame: Wet grey sand edge to edge; centred, the top of a deep navy matte backpack breaking the surf foam, its small black top grab handle upright and dripping, two black zip pulls resting on the sand just below; no horizon, no person, nothing else identifiable.
beats.impact: Camera locked, macro depth, one full wave cycle of sound (hiss, draw, silence) before the hand enters; hold one beat on the tightened knuckles. Cut motivated by the handle being pulled upward out of frame.

beats.title: Years, in one look
beats.feeling: The scale of his exile, how long and how alone, and the strangeness of holding a piece of the old world in his hands.
beats.framing: Wide vertical: sea screen-left, beach rising to palms screen-right. The castaway stands knee-deep in surf holding the bag by its top handle at arm's length, water sheeting off the navy body. On a black rock in the mid-ground behind his shoulder, hundreds of scratched tally marks catch the low sun. He turns and wades right toward the shore, bag hugged to his chest, exiting frame right.
beats.first_frame: A gaunt bearded man in a shredded white shirt and rolled trousers, knee-deep in surf, frozen mid-stare at the navy backpack held at arm's length; a wall of tally marks scratched into the black rock behind his shoulder; sea to the left, palms to the right, overcast sky.
beats.impact: Static wide, wind and surf only, no music yet. The eye lands on him and the bag, then drifts to the tally marks and starts counting. Cut on his first step toward shore.

beats.title: The zip that lets the light in
beats.feeling: Warmth, like a lamp switched on in a room he had forgotten existed.
beats.framing: Inside a dim palm-frond lean-to, medium close on the bag standing upright on packed sand, the man's hands entering from frame right (he arrived from the beach on the right, direction held). Thumb and finger take one black zip pull and draw the vertical front zip down; the bright yellow lining blooms out of the opening and throws a yellow cast up onto his beard and cheekbone. His eyes drop from the opening to something inside.
beats.first_frame: Dim shelter interior in brown-green shadow with one slit of daylight; the deep navy matte backpack upright and closed at frame centre, vertical front zip and front bucket pocket facing camera, two black zip pulls hanging, the man's weathered hand resting on the small top grab handle.
beats.impact: Slow push-in of a few centimetres as the zip opens; the zip's tooth-sound is the only audio, then the first warm piano note as the yellow lands on his face. Cut on his eyes dropping to the interior.

beats.title: Her
beats.feeling: Longing: the want of the whole film stated in one object, and the fear of what the years may have cost.
beats.framing: Close-up on hands and photograph. A palm-sized colour photo, edges water-stained, of a smiling dark-haired woman in a yellow kurta on a city balcony; his cracked thumbs hold its bottom edge, trembling. The soft yellow lining of the open bag fills the background. He tilts the photo toward the slit of light; a single drop of water hits the photo's corner.
beats.first_frame: The photograph just lifted clear of the yellow interior, still half in shadow, the woman's face turned toward the light, the man's two thumbs at its bottom edge, the bag's yellow lining and one black zip pull soft-focus behind.
beats.impact: Camera still; hold longer than is comfortable, a full two seconds on the photograph. Surf drops away, the piano motif resolves. Cut on his jaw setting: the decision to go.

beats.title: Everything goes in
beats.feeling: A grin in the dark: the deadpan pleasure of watching a rule break and keep breaking.
beats.framing: Low angle on the beach in gold hour, the open bag upright at frame centre with the yellow interior facing camera. Around it in a ring: coconuts, leaf-wrapped dried fish, a coil of vine rope, a flint, a signal mirror; across the foreground a carved wooden paddle and a hand-made fishing spear, both longer than the bag. His hands enter from frame right and post items in one after another: a coconut into the front bucket pocket, fish into the main compartment, rope, flint, mirror; the bag never bulges. Then the paddle, then the spear, slide in vertically and vanish. He pauses, looks at the bag, looks out of frame, shrugs.
beats.first_frame: The open navy backpack upright at frame centre on sand, yellow interior blazing, ringed by the survival haul laid out neatly; the spear and paddle lie across the foreground, clearly longer than the bag; the man's hands reach in from frame right for the first coconut.
beats.impact: Locked camera; items go in on a steady rhythm to a soft percussive pulse, each zip-pull click on the beat. The spear vanishing is the joke; the '30L' super lands at 19.5 s as the punchline that is also the true fact. Cut on his shrug.

beats.title: Leaving
beats.feeling: Resolve: he is going home, and he is taking only this.
beats.framing: Wide at dawn. The castaway walks screen-left into the surf with the packed navy backpack on his back, black padded straps over his shoulders, the front bucket pocket and two zip pulls catching first light, pushing a small lashed-driftwood raft ahead of him. The tally-marked rock is behind him screen-right, shrinking.
beats.first_frame: The man from behind at three-quarter, at the water's edge, the slim navy Transit Backpack squarely on his back with black padded straps visible, a driftwood raft at his feet, open sea to the left, palms and the tally rock to the right, pale dawn sky.
beats.impact: Slow lateral track keeping pace with him, surf and his breathing, the music bed opening up. Cut as the raft floats free of the sand.

beats.title: The photo faces home
beats.framing: Medium from behind him seated on the raft, open water on all sides. The bag sits upright in front of him against the mast pole with the front bucket pocket toward him; his hand tucks the photo's corner under one black zip pull so her face rides facing him. Beyond, a faint grey line on the horizon, screen-left.
beats.first_frame: The back of the man seated on the raft, the navy bag upright in front of him, one black zip pull between his fingers as he slides the photo corner beneath it, sea grey-blue in every direction, a faint horizon line to the left.
beats.impact: Camera lifts slightly with the swell; the surf has become open-sea wind; the piano motif once more, left unresolved. Cut on the horizon.

beats.title: Brand close
beats.framing: Code-composed card on deep navy: the customer's product photograph (transit_backpack_private_island_1) centred, the mokobara wordmark (mokobara_wordmark, used untouched) above it, the strings 'Transit Backpack' and '30L' beneath, 'mokobara.com' in the lower third.
beats.first_frame: Static card: deep navy field, product photograph centred, wordmark above, 'Transit Backpack' and '30L' below, 'mokobara.com' in the lower third.
beats.impact: Hard cut to the still; music resolves to one held note; two-second hold to black.

capacity_super.why: The punchline of the packing gag is the real capacity: the exaggeration is based on a truth, and the super states the truth the moment the spear vanishes.

brand_close_card.why: End on the package with the name: product photo, wordmark (asset mokobara_wordmark), product name, capacity and the URL as the ask.

mandatory.customer_words: the protagonist ... was on the island where he was kept for years
mandatory.realisation: Beat 2: a gaunt, bearded castaway in rags, with a rock face of scratched tally marks behind him; beats 1-7 all play on the same island geography.

mandatory.customer_words: the protagonist found his mokobara bag, while he was on the island
mandatory.realisation: Beat 1 opens on the bag's handle in the surf and his hand finding it; beat 2 he lifts it out; beat 3 he opens it.

mandatory.customer_words: in that bag he founds her wives photo
mandatory.realisation: Beat 4: the photograph lifted from the yellow interior, held for two seconds; beat 7: he tucks it under a zip pull to face him on the crossing.

mandatory.customer_words: a lot of stuff that he could use to go back. he packs food and stuff and goes back
mandatory.realisation: Beat 5: coconuts, dried fish, rope, flint, signal mirror, paddle and spear all packed; beat 6: he walks into the sea with the bag on his back and a raft; beat 7: on open water.

mandatory.customer_words: would be funny that he could keep his arms in the bag and food and so much stuff
mandatory.realisation: Beat 5 is the capacity gag: the food, the tools and his 'arms' (a fishing spear longer than the bag) all go in with no bulge, played deadpan, and the '30L' super lands as the punchline.

mandatory.customer_words: i would preferably give it the odysey movie angel ... Avoid getting copyright violoations from odysssey
mandatory.realisation: The castaway-returning-home shape is kept as a generic archetype; no named film, character, title, costume, prop or scene is referenced or reproduced; the castaway and the woman in the photo are invented people; the negative line forbids any likeness.

mandatory.customer_words: deep navy matte body; bright yellow lining; vertical front zip and front bucket pocket with two black zip pulls; black padded straps, small top grab handle
mandatory.realisation: Restated verbatim as the transit_backpack identity anchor in every prompt; each live beat shows at least one invariant in action (handle in beat 1, zip pulls and yellow lining in beat 3, bucket pocket in beat 5, padded straps in beat 6).
All three composed by code, never generated: '30L' as a super at 19.5-21 s and all three on the brand close card at 28-30 s.
Both used untouched on the code-composed brand close (beat 8); the product photo is also the likeness reference for every generated still.

mandatory.customer_words: aspect 9:16, count 1, multi_shot_story, video, motion.audio true, seconds 30, from generated
mandatory.realisation: One 30 s vertical film of eight contiguous beats, native audio generated per clip with a music bed added in code; no speech.

brand_timeline.in_context: The product is the brand presence from the first frame: the bag is on screen in every live beat (handle 0-4 s, full body 4-8 s, zip and yellow lining 8-12 s, lining behind the photo 12-16 s, packing 16-21 s, on his back 21-25 s, on the raft 25-28 s); the wordmark, product name, capacity and URL arrive on the code-composed close at 28 s.

last_frame: Brand close card on deep navy: the product photograph centred, the mokobara wordmark above, 'Transit Backpack' and '30L' below, 'mokobara.com' in the lower third.
